facts.statement: Hoplitosuchus is classified as a genus within the order Aetosauria.
The genus Hoplitosuchus was named by von Huene in 1938.
The only known species of Hoplitosuchus is Hoplitosuchus raui.
Hoplitosuchus belongs to the infraclass Archosauromorpha.
Hoplitosuchus is part of the unranked order Crurotarsi.
Fossils of Hoplitosuchus have been found in the Santa Maria Formation in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, dating to the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: Fossils have been found from the Santa Maria Formation in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil that date back to the Late Triassic.

facts.statement: The genus was originally named Hoplitosaurus in 1902, but was renamed Hoplitosuchus because the original name was already used for a dinosaur.
facts.quote: At first the genus was named Hoplitosaurus, but this name had previously been assigned to a polacanthine ankylosaurian dinosaur in 1902, thirty-six years before it had been referred to the aetosaur.

facts.statement: Hoplitosuchus is considered a nomen dubium because its holotype consists of unidentifiable osteoderms and other attributed material may be a mix of rauisuchian and dinosaurian remains.
facts.quote: Because the holotype specimen consists of unidentifiable osteoderms and any other material attributed to the genus may actually be considered a composite of rauisuchian and dinosaurian remains, Hoplitosuchus is now considered to be a nomen dubium.

facts.statement: The dinosaur Teyuwasu, now known as Staurikosaurus, was named in 1999 using material that was originally attributed to Hoplitosuchus.
facts.quote: The saurischian dinosaur Teyuwasu (now Staurikosaurus) was named in 1999 on the basis of material originally attributed to Hoplitosuchus.

facts.statement: Hoplitosuchus is a genus represented by a single species of aetosaurian archosaur that lived at the end of the Triassic period.
facts.quote: Hoplitosuchus es un género representado por una única especie de arcosaurios aetosáuridos, que vivió a finales del período Triásico.

facts.statement: Paleontologists currently do not consider Hoplitosuchus a valid genus and associate its remains with a mixture of fossils from other species.
facts.quote: Aun así, actualmente, los paleontólogos no tienen claro que sea un género y asocian sus restos a una mezcla de fósiles de otras especies.

facts.statement: Hoplitosuchus lived from the Carnian to the Norian stages, between 237 and 205.7 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Carnian to Norian (237 to 205.7 million years ago)
